author: Norma_T

title: A fantastic day in Barcelona!
text: A fantastic day in Barcelona! We had a short time to visit the city as we finished our cruise in Barcelona and our flight was in the afternoon. Isaac, our guide, picked us up at the port on time. We visited the most famous places in Barcelona and finished at the airport on time after enjoying this beautiful city.
author: kadreenam

title: Girona is beautiful.
text: Girona is beautiful. We booked a tour to Girona because some friends had been to Barcelona a few years ago and recommended we visit this medieval city. We thoroughly enjoyed its history, its stone streets, and its ancient cathedral. We had a great time, and the tour was excellent.
author: Q8902IBes

title: A fun tour of Gaudi! We wanted to visit the Sagrada Familia and other famous Gaudí buildings, so we booked this tour. Ou
text: A fun tour of Gaudi! We wanted to visit the Sagrada Familia and other famous Gaudí buildings, so we booked this tour. Our guide, Raquel, was very friendly and fun throughout the tour, which felt too short because we had such a great time with her.
author: lenoraj782

title: We love Barcelona
text: We love Barcelona! My husband and I booked a 4-hour private tour because we wanted to visit the city. Our experience was much more than we expected, highly recommended!
author: 689rimb

title: Barcelona private tour
text:
We did a private tour of Barcelona.  Our driver/tour guide was Juan.  He was on time and very knowledgeable and friendly.

We only had about 3 hours before going to our cruise ship.  He took us as close as he could to the church and we got out for a photo.  Also both sides of the mountainside to see the city view.  He was great and we felt safe with Juan.  We highly recommend Juan and Viator is lucky to have him.
author: Larry_D

title: Excellent tour
text: First time in Barcelona, best experience ever so happy with Barcelona exclusive private tours,  I booked a half day tours after docking in Barcelona Cruise terminal and the driver was very knowledgeable and we were really impressed

title: Great Tour
text: This tour was great!!! Our driver Coco was knowledgeable, engaging and very personable.  This was our first trip to Barcelona and he made the experience so wonderful.
author: Kim_W

title: Great experience with Alex as a tour guide!
text: Alex was excellent! He picked us up at the dock as requested and gave us a beautiful tour of Barcelona. He was very aware of the petty crime and insisted we drop our luggage off at the hotel prior to touring. He gave us lots of pointers of what to do after the tour And many well. Founded recommendations.
author: Susan_G
